tagline: A community bank alternative to super-regional financial institutions serving the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area
hero_kpi_rationale: Total assets of $10.5 billion reflect Eagle Bancorp's size and positioning as an independent community bank in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area, serving as the primary indicator of balance sheet capacity and market exposure.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets held by the bank, such as loans and investments.
kpis.description: Total assets reflect the size of the balance sheet and market exposure. They include primarily loans and securities.
kpis.signal: $10.5 billion in total assets at end of 2025.

kpis.name: Loans Held for Investment
kpis.explanation: Total amount of loans the bank holds in its portfolio.
kpis.description: Loans are the primary source of interest income. The portfolio is concentrated in commercial real estate and local businesses.
kpis.signal: $7.3 billion in loans held at end of 2025.

kpis.name: Total Deposits
kpis.explanation: Total amount of customer deposits, the bank's primary source of funding.
kpis.description: Deposits fund loans and investments. A stable deposit base is an advantage during periods of volatility.
kpis.signal: $9.1 billion in deposits at end of 2025.

kpis.name: Local Market Unemployment Rate (Washington, D.C.)
kpis.explanation: Unemployment rate in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area, where the bank primarily operates.
kpis.description: Higher unemployment may increase loan default risk, especially in sensitive sectors such as hospitality and services.
kpis.signal: Local unemployment rate rising to 4.4% at end of 2025.

kpis.name: U.S. GDP Growth
kpis.explanation: Annual economic growth of the United States, which influences credit demand.
kpis.description: Slower growth may reduce local economic activity and loan demand.
kpis.signal: GDP growth at 2.2% in 2025, down from 2024.

kpis.name: 10-Year U.S. Treasury Rate
kpis.explanation: Benchmark interest rate that directly influences the bank's net interest margins.
kpis.description: Higher rates may improve margins if loans are fixed-rate, but also increase funding costs.
kpis.signal: Average 10-year U.S. Treasury rate at 4.29% in 2025.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.11 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €0.7 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets held by the bank.
kpis.description: Balance sheet size reflects the bank's position in its local market.
kpis.signal: $10.5 billion in total assets at end of 2025.

kpis.name: U.S. GDP Growth
kpis.explanation: Annual economic growth of the United States.
kpis.description: Economic growth directly influences the health of the loan portfolio.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate risk, which may impact its net income and the economic value of its shares. The company's interest rate risk model shows moderate compression of net interest margin in the event of declining interest rates.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risk, which may impact the quality of its assets and its net income. The company's allowance for loan loss estimation process relies on assumptions and subjective judgments.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to liquidity risk, which may impact its ability to meet its obligations. However, the company's liquidity risk model does not indicate significant risk.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to regulations and laws that may impact its operations and net income. Changes in regulations may have a significant impact on the company.

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to market risk, which may impact the value of its assets and its net income. Market fluctuations may have a significant impact on the company.

risks.title: Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to operational risk, which may impact its efficiency and net income. However, the company's operational risk model does not indicate significant risk.

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to reputation risk, which may impact its ability to attract and retain customers. Negative events may have a significant impact on the company's reputation.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to cybersecurity risk, which may impact the confidentiality and integrity of its data. Cybersecurity attacks may have a significant impact on the company.

ai_positioning.summary: EGBN does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing.
